meta.name: generate-image
meta.description: Generate or edit images with AI models through the OpenRouter Image API (Gemini, Seedream, Recraft, GPT-Image, Riverflow). Use for photos, illustrations, artwork, concept art, visual assets, logos, and image editing or compositing from reference images. For flowcharts, circuits, pathways, and other technical diagrams, use the scientific-schematics skill instead.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成或编辑照片、插画等视觉素材
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要为文章或项目快速生成配图，又不想学笨重的设计软件。
copy.tagline_en: Create or edit photos, illustrations, and visual assets with AI models.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need visual assets and don't want to use complicated design software.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会调用脚本,通过 OpenRouter 的图像模型按文字生成新图,或根据指令修改已有图片,结果自动存成 PNG(默认 generated_image.png)。
howto.when: 当你要生成照片、插画、概念图等通用图像,或基于参考图做编辑时接管;流程图、电路图等技术示意图请改用 scientific-schematics。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude runs a script that uses OpenRouter image models to generate new images or edit existing ones from a text prompt, saving results as PNG (generated_image.png by default).
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want photos, illustrations, concept art, or other general images, or edits based on a reference image. For flowcharts, circuits, and technical diagrams, use scientific-schematics instead.

say_en.note: Saves generated_image.png in the current folder

say_en.note: Needs an input image path; enters edit mode
